redistribution_note: Datasets, adapters and evaluation artifacts derived from this target are for INTERNAL, NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH USE ONLY unless the grounding material is first segregated by licence or permission is obtained. Twelve of the twenty grounding files are Thanissaro Bhikkhu translations under CC BY-NC 4.0, so any commercial use requires the translator's permission. Two are Ānandajoti Bhikkhu translations under CC BY-SA 3.0, which requires attribution and share-alike on redistribution and on adaptations. CC BY-NC 4.0 and CC BY-SA 3.0 are not mutually compatible in one published redistributable work, so a public release of this dataset needs either segregation or permission; this is flagged for a human and is not decided here. Separately and independently of copyright, no SuttaCentral-derived text may enter any artifact of this pipeline, at any stage, including via a generator model's own recall of modern translations: SuttaCentral asks that its content not be used to create generative-AI datasets and this project treats that as binding. Attribution strings for each file are in that file's own header comment; the full ledger is in SOURCES.md.
